content.short: CNFT Tools helps you as it gives you a clear overview for different NFT projects on the Cardano blockchain.
content.description: CNFT Tools is a Cardano NFT analytics platform focused on rarity, collection discovery, and project-level data. Collectors can use it to inspect newly minted NFTs, compare traits, and understand how scarce an item is within a collection. For Cardano NFT projects, the platform provides a clearer overview of assets and metadata so buyers and holders can make better-informed decisions. Its core job is to turn raw collection data into searchable, collector-friendly NFT insights and ranking tools for users.
content.meta: CNFT Tools provides rarity rankings, collection analytics, and discovery tools for Cardano NFTs. Explore CNFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
